summary: Explains variables with the same name override each other by precedence; agree on where to define each variable, define it once, and note that variables (like ansible_user) override equivalent config, CLI and keyword settings.
questions: Where should I define my variables to avoid precedence problems?

answer_card.title: Choosing where to put a variable
answer_card.answer_md:
Same-named variables in different places override each other by precedence. Avoid trouble by agreeing on guidelines and defining each variable in **one place**.

Some settings can be set as a variable, in config, on the CLI or as a keyword (e.g. `ansible_user`, `DEFAULT_REMOTE_USER`, `-u`, `remote_user`). The **variable** wins, so host-specific values override general ones.
